_about: On This Day in Longhorn history. Keys are MM-DD. Every entry must have a source link.

11-17.text: No. 15 Texas beat No. 16 Iowa State 24-10 at Royal-Memorial Stadium.
Texas beat Oklahoma 26-14 at Clark Field in Austin.

11-18.text: Texas won 28-14 at West Virginia in Morgantown.
Texas shut out Arkansas 34-0 in Fayetteville.

11-19.text: Bijan Robinson ran for 243 yards and four touchdowns as Texas routed Kansas 55-14 in Lawrence.

11-21.text: In his last home game, Colt McCoy threw for 396 yards and four TDs in a 51-20 win over Kansas, becoming the winningest QB in college football history.

11-22.text: Arch Manning accounted for four touchdowns as Texas beat Arkansas 52-37.
Texas rallied from a 3-0 hole with fourth-quarter touchdowns by Johnny Cook and Tommy Ford to beat Texas A&M 13-3 on Thanksgiving in Austin.
Texas won 42-13 at College Station to close an unbeaten run through the rest of the regular season after its loss to Oklahoma.

11-23.text: No. 5 Texas beat Texas A&M 21-7 at Kyle Field.
No. 5 Texas shut out Texas A&M 25-0 in College Station on Thanksgiving Day.

11-24.text: Texas won 27-25 at Kyle Field in the last Thanksgiving meeting with Texas A&M before the Aggies left for the SEC.
No. 12 Texas beat No. 22 Texas A&M 43-17 in Austin.

11-25.text: Unbeaten No. 2 Texas held off Texas A&M 40-29 at Kyle Field to finish its first 11-0 regular season in 22 years.
Texas edged Texas A&M 7-3 before an estimated 20,000 fans, then the largest crowd in Texas history.

11-20.text: Texas routed Florida Atlantic 51-17 in Austin, its season-high point total, as Cody Johnson ran for a career-high 124 yards.

11-26.text: Colt McCoy threw four TD passes and ran for a career-high 175 yards as No. 3 Texas outlasted Texas A&M 49-39 at Kyle Field.
Earl Campbell ran for 222 yards and four touchdowns as No. 1 Texas beat No. 12 Texas A&M 57-28 to finish the regular season unbeaten.

11-27.text: Colt McCoy threw for 311 yards and accounted for four touchdowns as No. 2 Texas routed Texas A&M 49-9 in Austin on Thanksgiving night.
Ricky Williams ran for 259 yards and broke Tony Dorsett's Division I-A career rushing record as Texas upset No. 6 Texas A&M 26-24.

11-28.text: Texas sacked Texas Tech freshman Baker Mayfield seven times, three by Jackson Jeffcoat, in a 41-16 Thanksgiving win in Austin.
Cedric Benson ran 35 times for 283 yards and four touchdowns as Texas beat Texas A&M 46-15 at Kyle Field.
Duke Carlisle's 1-yard run with 1:19 left capped a comeback from 13-3 down as Texas edged Texas A&M 15-13 at Kyle Field.

11-29.text: Chris Simms threw for 278 yards and three touchdowns as No. 10 Texas beat Texas A&M 50-20 in Austin.
James Brown threw for 336 yards and four touchdowns and Ricky Williams added 145 rushing yards in a 51-15 rout of Texas A&M in Austin.
Earl Campbell ran for 127 yards and the defense picked off three passes as No. 17 Texas beat No. 8 Texas A&M 32-3 in Austin.

11-30.text: No. 3 Texas won 17-7 at Kyle Field in the first meeting with Texas A&M in 13 years, as Quintrevion Wisner ran for 186 yards.
No. 3 Texas shut out Texas A&M 17-0 in Austin.

12-01.text: No. 9 Texas fell 39-27 to No. 5 Oklahoma in the Big 12 Championship in Arlington despite a title-game-record 177 receiving yards from Collin Johnson.
Colorado edged No. 3 Texas 39-37 in the Big 12 Championship Game, ending the Longhorns' national title hopes.
Texas beat Texas A&M 28-27 in Austin before 82,518 fans to close the regular season.

12-02.text: Quinn Ewers throws four touchdown passes as Texas routs Oklahoma State 49-21 to win the Big 12 title in its final season in the league.

12-03.text: Texas crushes Colorado 70-3 at Reliant Stadium in Houston to claim the Big 12 championship.
